title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the virtue of Selfless Giving
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the virtue of Selfless Giving Posted On:
                23 APR 2026 10:02AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the virtue of Selfless Giving: “पद्माकरं दिनकरो विकचीकरोति चन्द्रो विकासयति कैरवचक्रवालम्। नाभ्यर्थितो जलधरोऽपि जलं ददाति सन्तः स्वयं परहितेषु कृताभियोगाः।।" The Subhashitam conveys, "The sun helps the lotus bloom, and the moon does the same for the lilies. Clouds shower water on their own; similarly, noble people do good to others without any expectation." The Prime Minister wrote on X; “पद्माकरं दिनकरो विकचीकरोति चन्द्रो विकासयति कैरवचक्रवालम्। नाभ्यर्थितो जलधरोऽपि जलं ददाति सन्तः स्वयं परहितेषु कृताभियोगाः।।" पद्माकरं दिनकरो विकचीकरोति चन्द्रो विकासयति कैरवचक्रवालम्। नाभ्यर्थितो जलधरोऽपि जलं ददाति सन्तः स्वयं परहितेषु कृताभियोगाः।। pic.twitter.com/gc9DyHbSnS — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) April 23, 2026 *** MJPS/VJ/SS (Release ID: 2254741) Visitor Counter : 105 Read this release in: Marathi Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the virtue of Selfless Giving Posted On:
